channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Thursday's public rental tape is a full six-venue confirm session, with CoreWeave's /pricing page back after yesterday's 404. Live re-read of Lambda / CoreWeave NA+EU / Crusoe / DigitalOcean / GCP TPU / AWS Capacity Blocks: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Lambda on-demand anchors hold at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97 all confirm versus Wednesday. CoreWeave NA OD Inference prints (H100 $6.16 / B200 $8.60) and spots match the last pre-404 series, so the restore is a confirm, not a tick. AWS Capacity Blocks still banners the rate card effective 7 Oct 2026 while the live table prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191 CONFIRM). Applied Digital's Brookwood / Delta Forge 2 campus is on its stated ~1 Oct construction window day, with a company community meeting tonight (6-8pm, G.G. Hardin Center); no primary groundbreak filing found, Brookwood City Council vote still pending per late-Sep local TV, and the hyperscaler tenant remains unnamed. PUCT 58481 still Interchange 218/219 (effective 10.08.2026); TCEQ Abbott update still due 19 Oct; ERCOT RFI still due 12 Oct CPT; Fermi x TensorWave Matador still due 31 Oct; Chicago O2026-0028856 still introduction-only.
